category_title: Struggling readers who use direct repetition of previous text to avoid new reading
scenario_title: Shared reading turn-taking avoidance via repetition
minimal_context: The student and interventionist are taking turns reading 'Miss Nelson is missing!' together.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's continue reading 'Miss Nelson is missing!'. I will read this sentence: 'The class was rude.' Now it is your turn.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I just read that part. Please look at the next line and read it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Accepts the speaking turn but does not attempt the unread text) Was rude.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Points to the next passage of text) Go ahead and read this next one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You 's gonna read the next one. I read this one.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's continue reading 'Miss Nelson is missing!'. I will read this sentence: 'The class was rude.' Now it is your turn.

STUDENT: Was rude or that one.

TUTOR: I just read that part. Please look at the next line and read it.

STUDENT: (Accepts the speaking turn but does not attempt the unread text) Was rude.

TUTOR: (Points to the next passage of text) Go ahead and read this next one.

STUDENT: You 's gonna read the next one. I read this one.

task.content: Shared reading of the book 'Miss Nelson is missing!'
task.learning_goal: acquiring the skills necessary for reading

context.materials: Miss Nelson is missing! (Allard and Marshall, 1977) book selected from several choices
context.time_context: 5th, 6th, or 7th session of a 30-minute pedagogical interaction

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: after the interventionist finished reading a sentence and shifted gaze to the child
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: declines to read. Instead he repeats, ‘Was rude or that one (Line 217)’
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: recognizing that an interactive turn is required on his part due to the previously established pedagogical expectations

behavior_patterns.condition: after the interventionist pointed to the next passage of text
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: persists in his avoidance, thus delaying any actual reading by countering, ‘You ’s gonna read the next one. I read this one (Line 224)’
behavior_patterns.internal_state: successfully delays having to read or potentially read unsuccessfully... postures the interventionist as unsuccessful at following along rather than risking an unsuccessful reading turn
related_quotes: You ’s gonna read the next one. I read this one.
